meta.title: HSC ATAR Calculator
meta.description: Project your NSW HSC ATAR from your courses and internal marks. Nothing you type leaves your browser.

noJs: This calculator runs in your browser and needs JavaScript turned on. Nothing you type leaves your browser.

header.intro: Enter each course and its internal mark on the subjects page; add rank, tasks or scaling detail only if you have it.

readout.capEmpty: Add subjects to see a projection.
readout.capIndicative: Indicative only — not yet eligible for an ATAR. See the checks below.
readout.capOk: Projected ATAR at the what-if marks.
readout.ring: Finished above about {pct}% of the Year 12 age group

s1.title: Add subjects and internal marks
s1.empty: The course and final mark is all you need

s2.title: Set your exam marks
s2.detail: Drag the pin, type an ATAR, or move the sliders

s3.title: Save expected and target
s3.none: A realistic set and a stretch set

checks.ok: Eligible for an ATAR — all UAC unit requirements are met.
checks.notEligible: Not eligible for an ATAR yet — the figures below are indicative only.
checks.needsFix: Some entries need fixing — see below.

empty.title: Add your subjects to start
empty.body: You only need each course and the final internal mark your school reported. Rank, task marks and exam marks are optional and can be added later. Nothing you type leaves your browser.
empty.note: Test data fills the calculator with a typical NSW student so you can see how it works. You can clear it at any time.

footer.disclaimer: Independent projection tool. Not affiliated with UAC or NESA. Scaling and ATAR mappings are approximations of published UAC data and change every year. Not an official result.

toasts.testLoaded: Test data loaded — a typical student's marks
toasts.tasksStopped: Task marks kept aside — using the final mark
toasts.tickOne: Tick at least one subject for the ATAR to adjust
toasts.loaded: Loaded your {label} marks into the sliders
toasts.reset: What-if marks reset to each internal mark
toasts.importNoSubjects: This file doesn't contain any subjects.

share.title: Share this projection
share.body: The link holds your courses and marks, packed into the link itself. Nothing is uploaded or stored anywhere — but anyone you send the link to can see those marks.
share.includeNameHelp: Off by default. Only your courses and marks are in the link.
share.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — select the link and copy it yourself.
share.openConfirm: Open the shared projection? It has {n} subjects and replaces what's in your calculator now. You can undo afterwards.
share.openConfirm1: Open the shared projection? It has 1 subject and replaces what's in your calculator now. You can undo afterwards.
share.opened: Shared projection opened — undo to go back
share.bad: That share link is damaged or incomplete.
share.tooLarge: That share link is too large to open.
share.empty: Add some subjects first — there's nothing to share yet.
